helpers.name: SND_AliasSetNeverPlayedTwice
helpers.exactOperation: alias->flags1 bit 1 is replaced with the boolean argument; all other bits are preserved
helpers.note: The exact PDB/source function name is preserved even though the helper writes bit 1 while GetNeverPlayedTwice reads bit 0. No attempt is made here to rename the function or infer why the source uses this name.

notYetEstablished: when SND_AliasSetNeverPlayedTwice is called with true or false
whether the runtime rejects, rerolls, advances, or otherwise handles an alias for which both policy and played-state bits are set
proofBoundary: The PDB gives exact function identities/prototypes/source lines and the evidence corpus gives exact per-function machine-code hashes plus Ghidra listings. This closes only these three helper operations for the SHA-pinned PC dedicated server. It does not establish the higher-level chooser or retail-client playback semantics.
